meta.title: Add slow tag for archived packages
meta.body_summary: Add //go:build slow build tag to archived packages and a cmd that imports them, so they are skipped during normal test runs to speed up the suite.

perf_labels.notes: Single commit adding //go:build slow to 66 archived files; PR self-closed by author ~3.5h after creation with no reviews or comments.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 134 changed lines across 66 files, this is a small uniform edit by absolute volume. Each file receives a 2-line build tag addition. It fits a trivial performance PR that was closed rather than merged, likely due to author decision without merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or PR comments were recorded in the dataset.
review_details.performance_claim: Skipping archived packages in normal test runs reduces test suite execution time.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR self-closed by author without merge, no review interaction.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple mechanical change (adding build tags to many files) was self-closed by the author ~3.5h later with no review engagement; the agent's ability to navigate repository conventions is sufficient, but process hurdles (lack of maintainer attention, self-close) prevented merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code-reading review in dataset.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after test run times; only narrative claim that skip will speed up normal test runs.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Added //go:build slow build tag to every Go file in the archived/ directory tree and cmd/ft2mochi/main.go to exclude these packages from normal test runs (go test ./...).
